metadata.title: The Rate of the Delsarte Bound for Binary Codes and Spheres
metadata.abstract: We give the asymptotic rate of Delsarte's linear programming bound for binary codes and spherical codes. This extends previous work of the author which formulated and proved an analogue of the conjecture of Afkhami-Jeddi, Cohn, Hartman, de Laat, and Tajdini for binary codes, obtaining the rate of the Delsarte linear program at distance $1/2-1/\pi$. The lower bounds introduce ideas from potential theory into the study of Delsarte's bounds, whereby the measures underlying a system of orthogonal polynomials give an obstacle problem. We solve the resulting obstacle problem in the case of binary codes and spherical codes, obtaining a closed form for the lower bound in terms of elliptic integrals. For the upper bounds, we relate the $N$-qubit construction for binary codes used in previous work of the author to the constructions in OpenAI's Chapter 2 for spherical codes and observe that they both involve interlacing spectra. This leads to a variational problem involving measures constructed from these spectra under the Markov-Krein correspondence. This variational problem admits an exact solution and matches the lower bound.

analysis.progressType: Delsarte 线性规划界的渐近速率
analysis.workSummary: 研究二元码与球面码的 Delsarte 线性规划界，给出匹配的渐近上下界。下界把正交多项式背后的测度转化为势论障碍问题，并用椭圆积分给出闭式表达；上界利用交错谱及 Markov–Krein 对应，解出相应变分问题。摘要说明该结果扩展作者此前在某个特定相对距离处的速率计算。
analysis.breakthrough: 以两套不同构造得到相同速率，刻画线性规划方法本身的渐近能力。
analysis.limitations: 仅依据官方英文摘要解读，尚未核读数学正文。确定的是 Delsarte 界的速率，不能等同于最优码的真实速率。适用距离范围和端点公式待正文核对；摘要引用 OpenAI 的构造不单独构成作者使用 AI 的披露。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第 4—5 页用途声明：作者与 GPT-5.6 Sol 共同形成球面码和二元码上界，曾与 Sol、Astra 探索论证加强；Opus 5.5 识别 MacWilliams 变换的相容性，并在作者指导下把半速率结果重述为薄障碍问题、找到关键引理的推广；稿件使用 Codex 起草。声明同时把二元情形的核心不等式化简归于作者的逐步认识。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.21263v1 · 第 4—5 页，Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
